acquisition_channels.details: Suggested research in the same groups, forums and communities where coaches discuss the problem; ask questions and respect group rules rather than pitching.

ideas.delivery: Software sends a game-day text to parents and returns a confirmation list. Before the app exists, the proposed validation test is to send the texts and compile the list manually.
